title: ASCEP Layer 1 — Hardware declaration
description: Layer 1 of the five ASCEP layers. Declares the silicon and its interconnect independently of any model or framework. Capacity is a function of all five layers; a hardware record alone MAY NOT be used to assert any capacity figure (C3).

ascep_version.description: ASCEP protocol version this declaration was produced under (semantic versioning; a change that alters numbers is a major bump).

gpu_model.description: Accelerator model name as sold (e.g. a datacenter GPU, TPU, or Trainium generation). Vendor-neutral; no default implied.

gpu_count.description: Total accelerator devices in the deployment. Binds every capacity figure to a topology (C3).

gpus_per_node.description: Accelerators per node. gpu_count MUST equal nodes * gpus_per_node.

memory_architecture.description: Whether the accelerator has its own dedicated memory ('discrete', e.g. HBM on a datacenter GPU) or shares one coherent physical pool with the host CPU ('unified', e.g. Apple Silicon, DGX Spark). This is the discriminator for the conditional requirements below: a unified part has no separately bindable VRAM, so vram_bytes_per_gpu is the wrong question there and usable_memory_bytes carries the budget instead.

vram_bytes_per_gpu.description: High-bandwidth memory per device, in bytes (decimal GB, not GiB). Required only when memory_architecture is 'discrete'; on a unified part the schema refuses a non-null value here, because there is no separately bindable VRAM to declare -- usable_memory_bytes carries the budget. Null only if unknown, with vram_bytes_per_gpu_u_reason set. Feeds ascep.capacity.kv_pool_bytes; a null here makes every KV figure (U).

vram_bytes_per_gpu_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when vram_bytes_per_gpu is null (C1).

usable_memory_bytes.description: The bytes the serving framework can actually bind for weights plus KV on a unified part, after the OS reservation, the display compositor, and any GPU wired-memory limit (e.g. iogpu.wired_limit_mb, ~65–75% of RAM by default on macOS). It is not total system memory. On a 'discrete' part it MUST be absent or null and vram_bytes_per_gpu carries the budget; the schema refuses a number here on a discrete part. Required when memory_architecture is 'unified'. Null only if unknown, with usable_memory_bytes_u_reason set. Declaring total system memory here overstates the bindable pool by tens of GB in the over-promising direction.

usable_memory_bytes_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when usable_memory_bytes is null (C1).

memory_type.description: Free-text memory technology annotation, e.g. 'HBM3e', 'LPDDR5X'. Required when memory_architecture is 'unified'; annotates hbm_bandwidth_bytes_s so a reader can tell a shared LPDDR pool from dedicated HBM. Null only if unknown, with memory_type_u_reason set.

memory_type_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when memory_type is null (C1).

dense_flops_precision.description: The dense precision the quoted dense_bf16_flops_per_s figure is measured at. Required whenever dense_bf16_flops_per_s is non-null. A sparse or FP4 headline quoted as if dense overstates the prefill bound by roughly 2x per precision step (the DGX Spark's 1 PFLOP is FP4, not dense BF16); this field exists so the precision can never be silently assumed.

dense_flops_precision_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when dense_flops_precision is null (C1).

thermal_behavior.description: Whether the part holds its datasheet bandwidth and FLOP/s across the sustained measurement window. Required when memory_architecture is 'unified'. 'throttles-under-sustained-load' makes every (M) and sustainable figure temperature-dependent, and a cold-started sweep is then a different measurement from a heat-soaked one. 'not-assessed' is a legal, honest value; omitting the question entirely would let throttling parts pose as sustained ones.

thermal_behavior_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when thermal_behavior is null (C1).

interconnect_intra_node.description: Intra-node interconnect and generation, e.g. 'NVLink gen4', 'PCIe gen5', 'InfinityFabric', 'other', or the literal string 'n-a' for a single-device part where no intra-node link exists. Required only when gpus_per_node > 1. Affects achievable tensor-parallel width; omitting it makes TP claims non-reproducible.

interconnect_inter_node.description: Inter-node interconnect and rate, e.g. 'InfiniBand 400G', 'RoCE 200G', 'Ethernet', or 'n-a' for single-node. Required only when nodes > 1.

node_exclusivity.description: Whether benchmark nodes were exclusive. 'exclusive' means true bare-metal exclusivity: nothing else held compute or graphics time. 'exclusive-process' means no other compute or graphics tenant ran during measurement, while the OS compositor and system services held their unavoidable share — no Mac can honestly declare 'exclusive', because WindowServer always holds GPU time, so without this value every Apple report would carry the HW-7 contamination banner forever and the banner would stop meaning anything. 'shared' invalidates cross-report comparison and MUST be surfaced in the report header.

driver_version.description: Accelerator driver version, exactly as reported by the system. The literal string 'n-a' is sanctioned for platforms with no separately versioned accelerator driver (Metal ships inside the macOS release); on such platforms the OS and runtime version belongs in compute_runtime_version. Null only if unknown, with driver_version_u_reason set. A fabricated version number on a platform that has none trains readers to ignore the field; 'n-a' keeps it honest.

compute_runtime_version.description: Compute runtime and version (CUDA / ROCm / XLA / oneAPI / equivalent; on Apple Silicon this carries the macOS release and Metal/MLX versions).

hbm_bandwidth_bytes_s.description: Accelerator-visible DRAM bandwidth, in bytes/s, annotated by memory_type (T). Input to ascep.capacity.roofline_decode_tok_s; without it the theoretical tier cannot be computed and the roofline_efficiency field MUST be null. On a unified part this bandwidth is shared with the CPU and the display, so a CPU-bound run also depresses the memory roofline — quoting the vendor peak as if private to the GPU overstates the decode bound.

hbm_bandwidth_bytes_s_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when hbm_bandwidth_bytes_s is null (C1).

dense_bf16_flops_per_s.description: Vendor-specified dense FLOP/s per device, at whatever precision dense_flops_precision names (T). Input to ascep.capacity.roofline_prefill_ttft_s. Apple publishes no GPU FLOP/s figure at any precision, so null + (U) is the expected honest value there; the consequence is that the prefill theoretical tier and roofline_efficiency are then null, and that consequence is stated here so it is not treated as silent non-conformance.

dense_bf16_flops_per_s_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when dense_bf16_flops_per_s is null (C1).

cpu_model.description: Host CPU model. CPU-side tokenization and scheduling affect measured TTFT; omitting this weakens reproducibility of layer-4 numbers.

cpu_cores.description: Logical CPU cores per node. Under an image or video workload the host CPU decodes and patchifies every image, so this is a capacity input, not an inventory fact: C1 then requires a notes entry saying whether the number is the machine's core count or an allocation's.

cpu_cores_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when cpu_cores is null (C1).

system_ram_bytes.description: Host system RAM per node, in bytes. Relevant to model load path, KV offload, and prefix-cache spill. On a unified part this aliases the same silicon as the accelerator pool and MUST NOT be added to usable_memory_bytes — summing the two double-counts the machine (HW-9).

system_ram_bytes_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when system_ram_bytes is null (C1).

storage_class.description: Storage class the weights load from (local NVMe, network filesystem, object store). Affects cold-start time, a required measurement.

model_load_path.description: Path or URI used to load the model during the campaign.

interconnect_intra_node_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when interconnect_intra_node is null (C1).

interconnect_inter_node_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when interconnect_inter_node is null (C1).

node_exclusivity_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when node_exclusivity is null (C1).

driver_version_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when driver_version is null (C1).

compute_runtime_version_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when compute_runtime_version is null (C1).

cpu_model_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when cpu_model is null (C1).

storage_class_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when storage_class is null (C1).

model_load_path_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when model_load_path is null (C1).

notes.description: Free-form prose keyed by field name, recording why a declared non-null value is what it is: that cpu_cores is a cluster allocation rather than the node's core count, or the method used to establish usable_memory_bytes on a unified part (HW-8). Complements the (U) mechanism, which can only justify a null. A note NEVER substitutes for a value, never satisfies C1 beside a null, and is not evidence: it changes no tier and no conformance grade. Optional except where a rule says otherwise: C1 requires a cpu_cores note on any report declaring image or video input, and HW-8 requires a usable_memory_bytes note on any unified part.
